case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Attributable student authorship and transparent, authorised AI assessment assistance.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Operative instruments (N002, N136, N141, N001) supported by N133 require the final submission to be the student's own work, prohibit unapproved or undisclosed GenAI use, and provide authenticity monitoring and appeal remedies.
case_summary.case_note: Curtin prescribes that GenAI use in assessment requires explicit Unit Coordinator permission and transparent disclosure, and that the final submission must be the student's own work (N002, N133, N136, N141). All S1 critical-risk safeguards—attributable authorship, disclosure, human accountability, equity, and appeal remedies—are addressed (D5=3, Critical gap=No), though Unit Coordinator permission criteria and steps remain undocumented (D2=2, D4=2). Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15.
